market.rules_primary: If the end-of-day S&P 500 index value on September 18, 2026 is above 7699.9999, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The market will close on September 18, 2026. The market will expire at the sooner of the first release of the data, or one week after September 18, 2026.

Pursuant to the Kalshi Rulebook, the Exchange has modified the Source Agency and Underlying for indices markets. See the rules for more information.

market.title: Will the S&P 500 be above 7699.9999 on Sep 18, 2026 at 4pm EDT?
